cell_line.evidence: HEK293 (ATCC CRL-1573) cells, a cell line with epithelial morphology isolated from the kidney of a human embryo, were maintained at 37°C and 5% CO2 atmosphere in DMEM/F-12 medium (Biowest, L0092) supplemented with 10% (v/v) FBS (Thermo Fisher Scientific, 10270-106), 40 mM HEPES, antibiotics (100 U/mL penicillin +100 μg/mL streptomycin, Thermo Fisher Scientific, 15140-122) and 50 μM uridine.
